make_gym_environment: create a gym environment by calling make with an environment id string and optional kwargs
register_gym_environment: register a new gym environment with an id and kwargs using the register function
parse_version_string: parse a dot-separated version string like 0.21.0 into a tuple of integers
list_compiler_gym_envs: list all registered CompilerGym environment names from the COMPILER_GYM_ENVS module variable
review_register_order_enforce: review the register function to understand how order_enforce is handled for gym version 0.21 and above
